settings.title: Settings
settings.search_scope.desc: Searching only inside the target window is faster and avoids clicking the wrong thing; use the whole screen if the button lives in a separate window
settings.match_threshold.desc: Scores below this count as not found. If matching broke after changing display scaling, try 70 first
settings.match_scale.desc: Search the template at multiple scales. Default 60%~200% covers 100% / 125% / 150% display scaling
settings.click_mode.desc: Real clicks are the most reliable (they move the cursor and need the window in front); background clicks leave the cursor alone but games usually ignore them
settings.click_activate: Bring target window to front before clicking
settings.click_activate.desc: Real clicks land on whatever window is in front, so the target must be focused
settings.click_restore_cursor.desc: Puts the pointer back afterwards so you can keep using the mouse
settings.click_verify.desc: Compares the pixels around the click point afterwards; retries and logs when nothing changed (useful when the target is covered)
settings.minimize_on_task: Hide the main window while a task runs
settings.minimize_on_task.desc: This window can cover MAA's button, which breaks both matching and clicking; when on, it hides to tray at task start and comes back at the end
settings.click_offset.desc: Fine-tune the hit point: positive X moves right, positive Y moves down
settings.template_dir.desc: Empty means config/templates. Put your own captured templates here after changing resolution
settings.template_capture.desc: Select a button on screen and save it as a template calibrated for the current resolution and scaling
settings.match_test.desc: Take a screenshot and match once with current settings; reports only, never clicks
settings.match_test.hint: Note: a self-captured template is at native screen size, so scale≈1.00 is normal; a built-in template matches at the system scaling (about 1.25 at 125%).
settings.ui_scale.desc: Scales fonts and controls for high DPI / small screens; repaints immediately, no restart required
settings.ui_scale.restart.tip: Rebuild all windows at the new scale (finish any running task first)
settings.ui_scale.applied.title: Interface scale applied
settings.ui_scale.applied.text:

tutorial.title: Beginner tutorial
tutorial.subtitle: First time here? Follow these 7 steps (about 3 minutes)
tutorial.s1.title: 1. Prepare the environment
tutorial.s1.body:
You need three things: MAA (MaaAssistantArknights), MaaEnd and the MuMu emulator.
Run each of them once manually first: make sure MAA can start Arknights and MaaEnd can finish one task, then configure MaaAuto.
tutorial.s2.title: 2. Change MAA startup settings
tutorial.s2.body:
Open MAA → Settings → Startup:
· Enable “Quit emulator when finished”
· (optional) Enable “Start emulator after launch”; if you don't, MaaAuto will remind you to start the emulator first
tutorial.warn_maa:
★ REQUIRED: in MAA you must enable “Quit emulator when finished”.
Otherwise the emulator stays open after the task, MaaAuto never sees the emulator-exit signal, and later stages or the next run can fail.
tutorial.s3.title: 3. Change MaaEnd's task list
tutorial.s3.body:
Open MaaEnd → Task list: add “Close program” or “Close emulator” as the LAST task.
Order matters: it must be last, otherwise MaaEnd closes itself before the tasks finish.
tutorial.warn_maaend:
★ REQUIRED: the last task in MaaEnd's task list must be “Close program” or “Close emulator”.
That task is the “MaaEnd finished” signal for MaaAuto; without it MaaAuto waits until timeout (2 hours by default).
tutorial.s4.title: 4. Fill in paths in MaaAuto
tutorial.s4.body:
MaaAuto → Settings → Paths: choose MAA.exe and the MaaEnd launcher.
Running only one of the two is fine — leave the other empty to skip that stage.
tutorial.s5.title: 5. Test matching before running
tutorial.s5.body:
Settings → Vision & Click → “Test matching”: if it reports score / scale, the template is recognized.
If not (new resolution, redesigned buttons): use “Capture template” to select the button, or lower the threshold from 80 to 70.
Always test once after changing machine or scaling.
tutorial.s6.title: 6. Run tasks and read the log
tutorial.s6.body:
Back to Home → “Run now”. During a run the main window is minimized to tray (so it can't cover MAA's buttons) and restored afterwards.
The Home log shows every step live; the full log lives in logs\<year>\<month>\<day>\run_N_<time>\task.log.
tutorial.s7.title: 7. Schedule and notifications (optional)
tutorial.s7.body:
Settings → Schedule & Notifications: run daily at a fixed time and push results to your phone via ServerChan / Webhook.
When something breaks: About → “Export logs”, and send the zip plus MAA's debug\asst.log if the run got stuck in the MAA stage.
tutorial.footer: Finish steps 2 and 3 before pressing “Run now” — that's what makes the first run succeed.
settings.schedule.times.desc: Runs the task at these times; add several, e.g. 08:00 and 20:30
